question: Which Hollywood couple just quietly ended their marriage?
story: The star of Ozark and the frontman of Foster the People just quietly ended their marriage. If you watched Ozark, you know Julia Garner as Ruth, the character who stole every single scene she was in. Her husband is Mark Foster, the guy behind that Pumped Up Kicks song you have heard a thousand times. According to E! News and TMZ, the two have separated after about six years of marriage. Here is the detail fans latched onto. Reports say they have already wiped nearly every photo of each other off their Instagram accounts. Garner was also reportedly spotted in both Paris and Los Angeles without her wedding ring, which is what first set the rumors flying. The two apparently met back in 2013 at the Sundance Film Festival, then reconnected years later and married in 2019. Neither has publicly said a word. Sometimes silence is the loudest breakup of all.
